svg.title: The message font re-rendered from the game image
svg.desc: All 96 eight-by-eight glyphs at $9000-$92FF, drawn one-to-one from the bytes in the disassembly. The message text in the game indexes these glyphs directly.
svg.text: The game's message font, re-rendered from $9000-$92FF
96 glyphs of eight bytes; character codes in messages index this table.
